pos.personaBrief: Klopp's Dortmund defended from a mid-block and attacked on the counter after regains, and he says he 'can't coach' Wenger's orchestra way. From 2018/19 Liverpool became more patient in possession, aiming to prevent counters (TFA 2020; PL 2023).

pro.personaBrief: The core idea is 'Schnelles vertikales Spiel nach Ballgewinn' (Spielverlagerung 2011). Liverpool also played long balls over City's defence, Van Dijk hit long diagonals and Alisson went long when pressed, while centre-backs built up calmly when there was time.

est.personaBrief: Dortmund's wingers tucked into the half-spaces and Firmino played as a false nine (TFA 2020). Klopp calls it 'organisiertes Chaos', but it rests on drilled running paths ('Laufwege eingehämmert'), while Liverpool spread the pitch with high full-backs.

lar.personaBrief: Dortmund attacked down one side, with wingers coming inside early into the half-spaces. At Liverpool the width came from Robertson and Alexander-Arnold (313 crosses; open-play crosses up from 12.8 to 18.0 per 90) rather than touchline wingers, with the front three playing narrow.

blo.personaBrief: The identity is 'Gegenpressing direkt nach Ballverlust', and 'no playmaker can be as good as a good gegenpressing situation'. Dortmund used a mid-block that did not always press the centre-backs; Liverpool pressed higher, with a high line and the most final-third regains in the league (PL 2022; TFA 2022).

mar.personaBrief: Klopp says his career was built on ball-oriented zonal defending inherited from Frank, and he rejects pitch-wide man-marking (2026-09-23). Match analyses show only man-oriented jumps by midfielders and forwards inside the press (Spielverlagerung 2016; TFA 2022).

pla.personaBrief: Klopp brings a fixed pressing identity to each club: he used the same 4-3-3 in all 38 games in 2021/22, and at Mainz 'we could beat better teams with our system'. He still made opponent-specific tweaks against City and played more on the counter away at Dortmund.

res.personaBrief: Klopp's 'heavy metal, I always want it to be loud' makes emotion and intensity part of the purpose. Yet it is a winning machine ('mentality monsters') that goes for the win rather than settling.

sis.personaBrief: The collective system lifts limited players: he made Marco Rose a Bundesliga player, Mainz beat better teams, and Dortmund signed bargains. Defensive duty is universal ('alle immer verantwortlich ... ALLE IMMER!'), though attackers are encouraged to be brave.

jog.personaBrief: The system is 'aggressive, exuberant ... exhausting' and comes with running targets (118km). Gegenpressing is called the best playmaker, so a non-running 10 has no place, although technical passers like Van Dijk and Fabinho were valued.

bas.personaBrief: Dortmund's 2010/11 champions were 'extrem jung' (the 'Kinderriegel', Götze promoted), and Klopp shows youth players a path to the first team. Squads were still built mainly through cheap signings, and the 2024 academy final win was forced by injuries.

lid.personaBrief: Klopp is a charismatic 'Menschenfänger' who 'redefined man-management', builds on trusting relationships and has a player-voted leadership group. He is also 'autoritärer als gemeinhin angenommen' and handles different personalities differently (Spielverlagerung 2011).
